The reference's background-task texts, captured verbatim from the
reference's own artifacts.

Reference: Antigravity CLI "agy" 1.4.7 (the vendor binary at
~/.local/bin/agy), running against this repository on 2026-10-25.

Provenance
----------
Conversation 45fde9e1-76d5-4b87-bd23-1b2c626bbf26 of the reference's own
brain directory:

  ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/45fde9e1-76d5-4b87-bd23-1b2c626bbf26/
      .system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl

The reference ran `go test -v ./internal/cliapp -run
TestAccountsPanelIsInvocableButNotListed` with "WaitMsBeforeAsync": 5000
(step 56); the command outlived the wait window, so the reference sent it
to the background as a task. Steps 61, 100 and 114 are three more
backgrounded commands from the same conversation.

The reference renders a backgrounded task in two shapes:

  1. the *step content* — what the reference logs for the step. It is the
     launch acknowledgement plus a "Task Description:" line and, when the
     command has produced output by then, a "Log output:" section. The
     three step contents below are that shape.
  2. the *function response* — what the model receives. It is the launch
     acknowledgement without the "Task Description:" line and without the
     "Log output:" section: the reference's own conversation store carries
     exactly that text for the `schedule` tool, whose result is the same
     acknowledgement (see testdata/result_texts_1.4.7.txt).

The clone implements shape 2: the model receives the launch
acknowledgement. The step contents below are kept as the evidence for the
wording and for the two extras the step content carries.
